# Pak Alumex Aluminium Industries

> Premium architectural aluminium systems for modern buildings — curtain walls, windows, doors, and custom profiles from Faisalabad, Pakistan.

- [Curtain Wall Systems](https://pakalumex.com/products/curtain-wall-systems): Commercial facade systems
- [Windows & Doors](https://pakalumex.com/products/windows-and-doors): Thermal-break openings
- [Sliding Systems](https://pakalumex.com/products/sliding-systems): Large-span sliding solutions
- [Office Partitions](https://pakalumex.com/products/office-partitions): Interior glass partitions
- [Structural Glazing](https://pakalumex.com/products/structural-glazing): Four-sided structural glazing
- [Custom Architectural Profiles](https://pakalumex.com/products/custom-architectural-profiles): Bespoke extrusions
